SELECT 
    EmployeeID,
    JobTitle,
    VacationHours
FROM (
    SELECT 
        BusinessEntityID AS EmployeeID,
        JobTitle,
        VacationHours,
        FIRST_VALUE(VacationHours) OVER (
            PARTITION BY JobTitle 
            ORDER BY VacationHours ASC
        ) AS MinVacationHoursByTitle
    FROM HumanResources.Employee
) ranked
WHERE VacationHours = MinVacationHoursByTitle
ORDER BY JobTitle;
